text:
jamie: Quick thought — for on‑prem/offline package delivery: propose adaptive chunking + hedged fetches + explicit rollback markers per-node. Want to avoid long tail retries on flaky links.

alex: Can you sketch how 'adaptive' works? fixed chunk sizes are easier for resume.

jamie: adaptive = start with larger chunk (8MB) on healthy link, drop to 512KB on repeated failures; chunk boundaries are content-aligned (object segment ids) so we can verify sigs per-chunk.

sophia: Important: operator UX — we must show resume tokens and per-component progress in console. don't make operator open logs to infer state :grimacing:

maria: Suggest adding 'hedged fetch' logic: dispatch to primary mirror + 1 backup after 150ms. whoever wins writes, others abort. reduces tail latency.

dan: Hedging helps latency but increases bandwidth. For air-gapped installs over physical media hedging is pointless. Need policy by transport type.

jamie: agreed. policy model: transport_tag = {network, sneakernet, satellite}. hedging only for network, off for sneakernet. config example:
```
transport_policy:
  network: {hedge_delay_ms: 150, max_concurrent: 2}
  sneakernet: {hedge_delay_ms: 0, max_concurrent: 1}
```

maria: checksum per-chunk + chaining signature (Merkle leafs) — so we can accept partial apply and resume without re-signing whole bundle.

alex: how do we coordinate rollbacks? if node applied chunk N then failed at N+1, operator chooses rollback point. we need idempotent apply and tombstone markers.

sophia: propose 'activation markers' that are durable in agent local DB: applied_chunks: [N], pending_activation: boolean. rollbacks are tombstone entries with reason + operator-ack.

jamie: also add 'deep retry' pattern for long-run backoff: exponential with capped attempts + operator notification after threshold. avoid infinite retries.

deploy-bot: pack-agent/hedge-fetch v0.3 queued to canary (5 clusters) — experiment started :eyes:

dan: nit — make sure we preserve strict ordering for signed manifests. chunk chain must be append-only to avoid TOCTOU with signature.

jamie: agreed. next steps: i'll write short RFC with perf sim (simulate 1k nodes on poor WAN) + safety matrix. action: jamie to draft by Wed, sophia to add UX hooks.

sophia: sounds good. :thumbsup:
